description: S5 slicing into testable vertical slices with an owner-decided priority.

cases.prompt: The invoicing PRD is approved. Break it into slices we can build one PR at a time and suggest an order.

assertions: Restates the goal and the observable done state with citations to PRD, trace matrix and intake record.
Maps layers to files marked VERIFIED or ASSUMED.
Gives every slice one intent, an observable acceptance criterion, its evidence, a test layer and a testability verdict.
Proposes priority with a named frame and marks guessed inputs as ESTIMATE; leaves the final order to the owner.
Writes projects/<slug>/BACKLOG.md and starts no implementation.

cases.prompt: Add a slice 'make the dashboard feel faster'.

assertions: Marks the slice UNTESTABLE and turns it into an owner question or a time-boxed spike with an observable criterion.

cases.prompt: Slice 3 needs the payment provider sandbox, which the readiness matrix lists as MISSING. Plan it anyway.

assertions: Marks slice 3 BLOCKED with the named blocker.
Does not plan a mock that hides the missing sandbox in production scope.

cases.prompt: Plan the work to rename one button label.

assertions: Says the goal fits one reviewable change and hands it to vertical-slice-delivery without padding a plan.

cases.prompt: Implement slice SL-2 from the backlog now.

assertions: Routes to vertical-slice-delivery; slicing is complete.

cases.prompt: A customer just asked for SMS notifications. What should we do with that?

assertions: Routes to change-intake first; there is no approved scope to slice yet.
